name: Michalis Hadjipantela - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on the role of simple tax rules and tax fragmentation in European competitiveness
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how tax rules in the European Union could be made simpler and more consistent. It asks the European Commission to cut paperwork for businesses, especially small ones, to make cross-border tax refunds and rules easier, and to help tax authorities share information and work together. It also asks for action to stop tax avoidance and to keep the global minimum tax deal working. This is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose simpler tax rules and less reporting.
- **Who it affects:** Small and medium-sized businesses, cross-border workers and investors, and national tax authorities.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests.
